name: Ryoujoku Video Satsuei
source:
The teacher Kusu Reiichi sells videos, taken by himself while raping girl students.
He attracts Hosokawa Erina, a grandchild of the school principal, by his comely appearance, and is allowed to marry her. But someone tipped off his true behavior and the engagement comes broken off. To take back the marriage, he begins to nail suspicious girls......!

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE014553.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
楠岭一老师出售自己强奸女学生时拍摄的视频。
他以俊美的外表吸引了校长的孙子细川惠里奈，并获准与她结婚。但有人泄露了他的真实行为，订婚终止。为了夺回婚姻，他开始对可疑的女孩下手……！

[来自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE014553.html]DLsite英文[/url]]
